name: Sporeling
lore: A mushroom-capped crawler that puffs sleepy spores when startled; the villagers call them harmless, which is exactly how the trouble starts.

name: Cave Roach
lore: A boot-sized scavenger bold enough to steal mushrooms straight out of your basket and stare you down while it chews.

name: Whisper Bat
lore: A leathery flier that repeats the last voice it heard, luring the curious deeper with words that were never its own.

name: Dust Skitter
lore: A ball of grit and legs that rolls down the tunnel walls and uncurls only to bite.

name: Gloomcap Sentinel
lore: A bulbous guardian rooted at the hollow's mouth, its cap a lantern of sickly light that dims the instant before it strikes.

name: Pale Grub
lore: A blind, fat larva that chews through stone and the roots that hold it, leaving tunnels that collapse behind it.

name: Mycelium Weaver
lore: A pale horror that spins its webs from living fungus, stringing the warren with strands that drink the warmth from anything they touch.

name: Spore Spitter
lore: A stalk that bends like a bow and looses bursts of choking spores at anything that moves.

name: Rotling
lore: A reeking little beast grown entirely out of the warren's rot, quick, hungry, and always in threes.

name: Capfather
lore: The warren's ancient heart: a mushroom the size of a barn that walks on roots like legs and calls its children with a hum you feel in your teeth.

name: Rootling I
lore: A sprout of the Capfather, half his size and twice as eager.

name: Rootling II
lore: A sprout of the Capfather, half his size and twice as eager.

name: Root Gnawer
lore: A dog-sized rodent that files its teeth on living roots and is furious at anything that interrupts the meal.

name: Blind Mole
lore: A furred boulder of a burrower that navigates entirely by sound and hates every noise you make.

name: Pale Crawfish
lore: A blind freshwater hunter with a spear for a snout, patrolling water it has never once seen.

name: Silt Crawler
lore: A shelled bottom-feeder that rises in clouds of silt to swallow whatever sinks.

name: Drownmoss
lore: A drifting mat of weed that wraps an ankle and pulls, patiently, toward the deep.

name: Cinderlantern Swarm
lore: Grotto fireflies burning far too hot, their light a lure and their touch a brand.

name: Moss Lantern
lore: A single firefly grown vast and slow, its abdomen a lantern that never dims and never cools.

name: Grotto Crawler
lore: A long-legged hunter that skates across the water's surface, drawn to the light like everything else down here.

name: Sporeguard
lore: Two-meter caps that march in step, their spores laying down a wall of choking dust ahead of them.

name: Cap Knight
lore: A serpent armored in bark and fungus that guarded the throne's steps once and never left.

name: Mycelium Priest
lore: A pale minister of the rot that sings to the warren and answers your blows with a chorus of spores.

name: Mycelarch
lore: The mother of every mushroom in the hill, a vast pale crown of a creature that speaks through its children's minds and has already decided what you will become.

name: Spore Sentinel I
lore: A bodyguard woven from the Mycelarch's own threads.

name: Spore Sentinel II
lore: A bodyguard woven from the Mycelarch's own threads.

name: Rot Herald
lore: The throne's speaker, whose hiss carries the Mycelarch's will down the hall.

name: Bramble Hound
lore: A lean hunter grown from hedge and hunger, its bark-plated hide cracking as it runs.

name: Thornling
lore: A fistful of briars that walks, pricking anything that comes near.

name: Greenpelt Wolf
lore: A wolf so overgrown with moss it looks like a moving hill, swift despite all that green weight.

name: Yearling
lore: The pack's runt, quick and quiet and always the first to circle behind you.

name: Thornsinger
lore: A serpent whose scales are living bark; when it sings, the whole grove forgets which way is out.

name: Chorus Vine
lore: A vine that answers the Thornsinger in a whisper of leaves and tightens when you answer back.

name: Grove Stalker
lore: A deer that walks in the singer's shadow, patient until it is not.

name: Meadow Hornet
lore: An armored wasp the length of your arm, its blade grown long and its temper longer.

name: Paper Warden
lore: A hornet that never leaves the nest, patient as a held breath and just as sudden.

name: Thicket Tyrant
lore: A boar gone feral and green, its tusks wound through with thorn-vines, charging down anything that crosses its clearing.

name: Thorn Guard I
lore: A brute of the thicket that fights on its knuckles and settles every argument with the nearest tree.

name: Thorn Guard II
lore: A brute of the thicket that fights on its knuckles and settles every argument with the nearest tree.

name: Orchard Sentinel
lore: An orchard that grew a mind and then a body, lumbering between the stone trunks it used to be.

name: Fruit Wasp
lore: A wasp that nests in the petrified fruit and takes the orchard personally.

name: Hollow Stag
lore: A stag whose antlers flower and rot in the same breath, its shadow walking half a step behind it.

name: Eye-Bloom
lore: A bloom that opens only when watched, and watches back.

name: Shadow Fawn
lore: The stag's shadow, given a shape and a temper of its own.

name: Antlered Huntsman
lore: The stag's herald, a crowned beast that runs its prey to exhaustion and is never once out of breath.

name: Pack Thorn I
lore: A hound of the hunt, quick through the brush and quicker to call the others.

name: Pack Thorn II
lore: A hound of the hunt, quick through the brush and quicker to call the others.

name: Witherbloom
lore: A vast flower crowned like a lion that drains the color out of whatever it faces.

name: Blight Crawler
lore: A pale crawler that spreads the wither wherever it walks.

name: Grey Gardener
lore: A beast that tends the blight like a crop and resents the harvest being interrupted.

name: Verdant Sovereign
lore: The crowned spirit of the overgrowth, a lion of leaf and bloom that speaks for every root in the valley and buries its enemies to feed them.

name: Court of Thorns I
lore: A rank of briars that closes like a door when the Sovereign commands.

name: Court of Thorns II
lore: A rank of briars that closes like a door when the Sovereign commands.

name: Sovereign's Herald
lore: The court's crier, whose song is the sentence and whose bite is the sentence carried out.

name: Bloomguard
lore: A walking grove that shields the Sovereign with its own grown body.

name: Mudback Crab
lore: A crab the size of a cart, armored in mud and the coins of everyone who tried the crossing.

name: Drown Walker
lore: A dog that went into the water and came back wrong, still fetching something no one threw.

name: Saltmarsh Stalker
lore: A serpent the color of reeds that has eaten a hundred careless travelers and remembers none of them.

name: Reed Lurker
lore: A mat of razor sedge that lies level with the water and waits.

name: Reef Warden
lore: A crystal-shelled guardian that has watched the reef for an age and brooks no visitors.

name: Gilded Eel
lore: An eel scaled in stolen gold that strikes like a thrown spear.

name: Coral Crab
lore: A squat crab whose coral growths make it look like part of the reef, which is the point.

name: Tidehollow Horror
lore: A jellyfish grown vast in the dark, its lights spelling out patterns meant to be read and never worth reading.

name: Grotto Newt
lore: A newt that swims in the rising water and waits for it to do the work for it.

name: Keeper of the Kelp
lore: An ancient tortoise that tends the kelp like a garden and strangles intruders like weeds.

name: Kelp Shade I
lore: A drifting guardian that floats between the stalks where nothing should be able to see it.

name: Kelp Shade II
lore: A drifting guardian that floats between the stalks where nothing should be able to see it.

name: Flooded Villager
lore: Someone who stayed below the waterline too long, still polite, still drowning.

name: Waterlogged Hound
lore: The village dog, which never stopped guarding a house that is no longer there.

name: Silt Wretch
lore: A shelled thing that has moved into the flooded cellars and does not intend to leave.

name: Blackwater Lurker
lore: A toad of the fen whose croak sounds like a person calling for help from very far away.

name: Fen Wisp
lore: A drifting light that leads travelers off the path and into the peat, where the fen keeps what it takes.

name: Mire Crawler
lore: A blood-drinker of the stagnant water, grown large on whatever the fen drowns.

name: Deepseeker
lore: A jellyfish that scatters lights like coins across the surface, patient as a fisherman and just as fond of hooks.

name: Hook-Mouth I
lore: A hunter that waits beneath the lights for whatever comes to gawk.

name: Hook-Mouth II
lore: A hunter that waits beneath the lights for whatever comes to gawk.

name: Bell-Ringer
lore: A drowned thing that rings the sunken bell, and every toll calls another of its kind.

name: Drowned Acolyte I
lore: A worshipper who never left the pews, still kneeling in the green dark.

name: Drowned Acolyte II
lore: A worshipper who never left the pews, still kneeling in the green dark.

name: Nave Guardian
lore: The chapel's old guardian, whose shell has become part of the altar.

name: Leviathan
lore: An ancient serpent-turtle of the deep shelf that has sunk fleets for their glitter and holds the whole coastline in its slow patience.

name: Tide Herald
lore: The Leviathan's herald, whose wake is the signal to flee.

name: Reef Horror I
lore: A light that has drifted up from the deep trench, cold and wrong and enormous.

name: Reef Horror II
lore: A light that has drifted up from the deep trench, cold and wrong and enormous.

name: Drowned Choir
lore: A chorus of the drowned, singing the Leviathan's coming.

name: Frostguard
lore: A soldier of packed snow who has stood at the gate so long the gate grew up around it.

name: Frostplume Sentry
lore: A bird of ice that struts the wall, its crow loud enough to start the avalanches it relies on.

name: Whiteout Shade
lore: A shape of snow and antler that wears the face of whoever enters the storm.

name: Rime Crawler
lore: A pale spider that walks the whiteout on frozen points, silent and very fast.

name: Lake Wyrm
lore: A serpent of clear ice whose coils are visible through the floor you are standing on.

name: Ice Skater
lore: A spider that glides the lake's face, hunting anything that cracks the surface.

name: Frozen Herd
lore: The lake's drowned herd, walking the bottom in a slow, endless migration.

name: Rime Wretch
lore: A shape of frost and old cloth that moves only when you exhale.

name: Hollow Stag of Ice
lore: A stag of clear ice that has stood in the hollow so long it has forgotten the way out.

name: Ice-Warden
lore: A colossus of blue ice that carries the pass on its shoulders and crushes trespassers down into the permafrost.

name: Warden's Hound I
lore: A spider of the Warden's leash, skating out to meet anything that moves.

name: Warden's Hound II
lore: A spider of the Warden's leash, skating out to meet anything that moves.

name: Glasswood Stalker
lore: A predator that hunts by the cracking of glass, hearing you long before it sees you.

name: Shard Beaver
lore: A beaver whose tail is a slab of crystal and whose dam is a wall of prisms.

name: Prism Wasp
lore: A wasp of frozen light that refracts into a dozen copies as it dives.

name: Glacier Howler
lore: A wolf of the ice that howls down through the glacier's cracks and is answered by the whole mountain.

name: Frozen Pack I
lore: The pack's cousins, walking the white emptiness where the sun is only a rumor.

name: Frozen Pack II
lore: The pack's cousins, walking the white emptiness where the sun is only a rumor.

name: Frozen Falcon
lore: A bird that has hung in the ice for a century and is not, despite appearances, dead.

name: Icicle Chicken I
lore: A bird that lays frozen eggs and defends them with a comb of spikes.

name: Icicle Chicken II
lore: A bird that lays frozen eggs and defends them with a comb of spikes.

name: Cave Hermit
lore: A bear that slept through the freeze and woke up considerably grumpier than it went to sleep.

name: Courtier of Rime
lore: A noble of the winter court, elegant as a snowdrift and just as lethal to anything warm.

name: Frozen Herald
lore: The court's crier, whose crow opens the session and closes the doors.

name: Statue Guard
lore: A guard so still the court forgot it was ever alive.

name: Hoarfrost Queen
lore: The crowned sovereign of the eternal winter, whose displeasure is measured in blizzards and whose mercy is measured in none.

name: Queen's Guard I
lore: A colossus of the Queen's own cold, standing where she will not be touched.

name: Queen's Guard II
lore: A colossus of the Queen's own cold, standing where she will not be touched.

name: Crown Herald
lore: The Queen's voice, sharp enough to freeze a word in the air.

name: Winter Shade
lore: The Queen's whisper, crawling out of the drifts when the court grows quiet.

name: Ash Hound
lore: A wolf of banked embers that shakes sparks loose as it runs, its coat always smoldering.

name: Cinder Flea
lore: A squirrel-sized nuisance that hoards coals and throws them at anything that gets close.

name: Emberpelt Prowler
lore: A tiger whose stripes are seams of molten ember; the burned trunks lean inward when it passes.

name: Smoldering Snag
lore: A cloud of fireflies nesting in a dead trunk, hot enough to set it burning again.

name: Ash Crawler
lore: A hound of the ash flats that has learned to walk on the crust without breaking through.

name: Magma Pup
lore: A young crocodile of cooling basalt, its mouth a furnace and its temper worse.

name: Scald Newt
lore: A tortoise whose shell is a small caldera, venting steam and quite at home.

name: Boil Hound
lore: A hound that hunts the boil line, where the water hides what the fire cooks.

name: Spring Horror
lore: An old turtle crusted with mineral terraces, as much hot spring as beast.

name: Scalded Wretch
lore: A monkey that fell in and came out cooked and furious.

name: Forgebeast
lore: A ram whose fleece is molten and whose horns are forge-hot; it feeds the mountain's fires and charges anything that interrupts the smithing.

name: Bellows Fiend I
lore: A monkey that works the great bellows and throws the coals it can't use.

name: Bellows Fiend II
lore: A monkey that works the great bellows and throws the coals it can't use.

name: Obsidian Stalker
lore: A cat of black glass whose edges are sharp enough to cut the heat itself.

name: Stair Wisp
lore: A drifting coal-spirit that lights the steps and betrays them.

name: Shard Ram
lore: A ram of cooled lava plates that headbutts the stair until it falls on those below.

name: Ember Monkey
lore: A mischief of monkeys juggling stolen coals, delighted with everything and sorry about nothing.

name: Tallow Ape
lore: The biggest of the troop, its tail a torch and its grin a warning.

name: Sparrowcinder
lore: A squirrel that buries burning acorns and forgets every single cache.

name: Ringmaster of Sparks
lore: A showman ape in a scorched coat who insists the games are fair and the exits are all closed.

name: Cannon Chicken
lore: A barnyard bird loaded into a brass tube and fired at the audience, cackling the whole way.

name: Puppet of Ash
lore: A beast that dances on strings of ember and only stops when the music does.

name: Caldera Sentinel
lore: A crocodile of lava that patrols the rim, patient as the stone and twice as heavy.

name: Rim Crawler
lore: A tortoise that has crossed the rim so many times it has worn a path to the edge.

name: Eruption Hound
lore: A hound that runs the rim just ahead of the next vent's opening.

name: Pyroclast
lore: The living core of the volcano, a beast of magma and cinder that is the mountain's temper made flesh; when it wakes, the sky rains glass.

name: Caldera Guard
lore: A crocodile grown in the caldera, armored in the mountain's own cooling skin.

name: Ember Ape I
lore: A troop-ape that followed the heat down and never came back up.

name: Ember Ape II
lore: A troop-ape that followed the heat down and never came back up.

name: Magma Herald
lore: The heart's herald, whose shell cracks wider with every beat.

name: Spark Hound
lore: A lean wolf of static charge that runs ahead of the thunder and waits for it to catch up.

name: Ridge Gnat
lore: A mouse-sized nuisance that arcs between your feet and giggles in static.

name: Static Stag
lore: A stag whose antlers are live wires; the meadow's hush comes from everything hiding.

name: Charge Hare
lore: A hare that carries a charge in its fur and startles easily, to everyone's cost.

name: Field Mouse
lore: A whole field of mice, all charged, all watching.

name: Herd Bull
lore: The herd's enforcer, a stallion of forked lightning that runs the meadow's edge and turns trespassers back with their fur smoking.

name: Volt Doe I
lore: A doe whose antlers hum, one of a hundred that move as one.

name: Volt Doe II
lore: A doe whose antlers hum, one of a hundred that move as one.

name: Chasm Weaver
lore: A beaver that dammed a thunderstorm instead of a river, its tail a bar of blue-white current.

name: Arc Crawler
lore: A crawler that walks the copper wire and lights it as it goes.

name: Wire Hound
lore: A hound that paces the far edge, waiting to see whether you fall.

name: Stormherd Alpha
lore: The first of the storm-herd, a stallion born of a lightning strike that leads the herd and the weather both.

name: Herd Runner I
lore: The alpha's outriders, moving as one animal at the herd's flanks.

name: Herd Runner II
lore: The alpha's outriders, moving as one animal at the herd's flanks.

name: Bolt Sentinel
lore: A creature of frost and current that guards the stair, its quills crackling between shards of ice.

name: Climb Crawler
lore: A crawler that nests in the stair's cracks and lights them from below.

name: Thunder Wisp
lore: A dam-keeper that has dammed the stair itself and charges a toll in sparks.

name: Beacon Thief
lore: A wolf that swallowed the tower's light and glows with the stolen flame, more beacon than beast.

name: Tower Wretch I
lore: A swarm that moved into the dark tower and made it their nest.

name: Tower Wretch II
lore: A swarm that moved into the dark tower and made it their nest.

name: Warden of Currents
lore: The tower's old warden, still drawing power from a beacon that is no longer there.

name: Copper Falcon
lore: A raptor whose wings trail sparks, and whose cage is its own idea.

name: Voltaic Hen
lore: A bird that lays sparks instead of eggs and fusses if you take them.

name: Wire Weaver
lore: A beaver that builds the aviary's cage from live wire and never gets bitten.

name: Conduit Warden
lore: A warden grown into the spire's conduits, its body a living coil that discharges when disturbed.

name: Arc Servant I
lore: A servant of the spire, running its charge from room to room.

name: Arc Servant II
lore: A servant of the spire, running its charge from room to room.

name: Spire Howler
lore: A howler that can hear the charged air thin before the spire releases.

name: Skybreaker
lore: The crowned keeper of the peak's eternal storm, a stallion wreathed in silent lightning that splits the sky when it displeases him.

name: Crown Guard I
lore: A guard of frost and charge, standing where the crown will not be touched.

name: Crown Guard II
lore: A guard of frost and charge, standing where the crown will not be touched.

name: Thunder Herald
lore: The crown's herald, running the storm's edge to call the strike in.

name: Arc Choir
lore: A thousand small voices, all humming the same note, all charged.

name: Quarry Guard
lore: A troll of stacked stone that never got the order to stand down.

name: Grit Hound
lore: A hedgehog of sharp slate that rolls the trails and takes a toll in ankles.

name: Stonefall Stalker
lore: A cat of loose rock that walks the gallery ceilings and drops what it doesn't need on whoever is below.

name: Pit Wretch
lore: A digger of the pits that has made peace with the dark and war with everything else.

name: Dust Mite
lore: A wasp that nests in the rubble and stings like a falling chisel.

name: Boulder Run Runner
lore: A boulder that has been rolling so long it grew opinions, and its opinion is that you should move.

name: Pebbleback
lore: A smaller relation of the boulder, faster, meaner, and far more numerous.

name: Hall Termite
lore: A pale workman of the deep that builds with stone and eats with it too.

name: Soldier Termite
lore: A soldier with a head like a hammer and a grudge like a load-bearing wall.

name: Tunnel Grub
lore: A grub that widens the halls a mouthful at a time and is always hungry.

name: Quarry Tyrant
lore: The foreman of a quarry abandoned a century ago, still shouting orders at a crew of one.

name: Slate Brute I
lore: A boulder-picker the Tyrant set to guard the shaft mouth.

name: Slate Brute II
lore: A boulder-picker the Tyrant set to guard the shaft mouth.

name: Foundry Golem
lore: A furnace given legs and a mouth, its belly full of molten metal.

name: Slag Crawler
lore: A tortoise of cooled slag that carries the foundry's waste and its temper.

name: Anvil Ape
lore: A smith-ape that beats metal all day and anything else at night.

name: Standing Stone
lore: A monolith that has stood for an age and, this evening, decided to walk.

name: Circle Warden I
lore: A warden of the circle that has counted the stones every night and found the count wrong.

name: Circle Warden II
lore: A warden of the circle that has counted the stones every night and found the count wrong.

name: Grind Maw
lore: A crocodile of granite plates that swallows the tunnel behind it as it advances.

name: Deep Crawler
lore: A toad that sits so still the tunnel grew around it, and now it is the tunnel.

name: Cave Brute
lore: A brute that has made itself at home in a place that has no home in it.

name: Vault Guardian
lore: A stallion of clay and standing stone, the vault's last defense and its first thought.

name: Vault Keeper
lore: A keeper whose amber eyes have watched the vault since before the quarry.

name: Geo Wasp
lore: A wasp that mines the vault's seam and defends it to the last.

name: Terravore
lore: The buried heart of the underearth, a toad of boulders and ore that is the mountain's slow, patient will given a mouth.

name: Ore Hound
lore: A hound of ore that rolls down the vault's throat to meet intruders.

name: Stone Herald
lore: The heart's herald, whose tread is the mountain shifting in its sleep.

name: Vault Shade
lore: The vault's shadow, which has kept the same watch as the keeper and never blinked.

name: Grinding Deep
lore: The deep's own warden, drawn up to the heart to defend it.

name: Grave Hound
lore: A hound that kept a gate in life and keeps it still, its ribs showing through smoke.

name: Riser
lore: A farm bird that would not stay buried, strutting the road with a comb like cooling ash.

name: Mist Stalker
lore: A cat of mist that has no outline of its own, only the suggestion of one.

name: Fog Wretch
lore: A smudge of soot between the milestones that keeps the road tidy and its travelers tidier.

name: Gallows Keeper
lore: An owl that keeps a ledger of everyone who passes beneath the dead branches, and it has your name.

name: Carrion Crow
lore: A bird that has grown fat on the orchard's harvest and does not share.

name: Bough Crawler
lore: A drinker that nests in the high branches and drops on the unwary.

name: Candle Wretch
lore: A vault keeper that has tidied the candles for a thousand years and resents every visitor.

name: Guttering Shade
lore: A light that drifts between the coffins, dimming whenever it is looked at.

name: Crypt Hound
lore: A hound that guards a house of the dead and takes its duty very seriously.

name: Pale Rider
lore: A riderless horror of the marches that has broken a hundred horses and is now shopping for a new one.

name: Rider's Hound I
lore: A hound of the Rider's hunt, running the march's edge.

name: Rider's Hound II
lore: A hound of the Rider's hunt, running the march's edge.

name: Hollow Chorister
lore: A congregation that sings without mouths, the sound hollow and patient and wrong.

name: Choir Warden
lore: A warden that keeps the choir's time and punishes those who break it.

name: Silent Brother
lore: The one who does not sing, and is therefore the one to fear.

name: The Widow
lore: The pale lady of the marches, whose veil is smoke and whose court is whoever was too slow to leave.

name: Veiled Attendant I
lore: A courtier who attends the Widow still, long after the attending stopped mattering.

name: Veiled Attendant II
lore: A courtier who attends the Widow still, long after the attending stopped mattering.

name: Court Shade
lore: The court's enforcer, which has no shape but a great deal of intent.

name: The Hunger
lore: A vast mosquito-thing fed on a swamp that was fed on something worse; its needle is longer than a spear.

name: Ravenous Crawler
lore: A crawler that follows the Hunger's scent and finishes what it leaves.

name: Gorge Wretch
lore: A hound of the hunger, ribs showing, still eating.

name: Black Choir
lore: A choir of owls that sings the cathedral's hymns and descends on any who interrupt.

name: Cathedral Guardian
lore: A guardian of the nave that has no body to bury and no patience to spare.

name: Bishop of Ash
lore: The cathedral's shepherd, whose flock is the whole march and whose sermon is the dark.

name: Nave Crawler
lore: A drifting light of the nave, cold and wrong and enormous.

name: Umbragore
lore: The shadow sovereign of the marches, a lion of black smoke and silent lightning whose mane is a standing storm and whose reign is measured in graves.

name: Shadow Herald
lore: The sovereign's herald, whose pounce is the herald's only announcement.

name: Court of Ash I
lore: The sovereign's court, still bowing, still marching.

name: Court of Ash II
lore: The sovereign's court, still bowing, still marching.

name: Legion Shade
lore: A legion of the sovereign's risen, strutting in the sovereign's shadow.

name: Spine Crawler
lore: A crocodile of black basalt that walks the spine's vertebrae and eats whatever stops to admire the view.

name: Scale Hound
lore: A hound that dens in the fallen scales and considers the spine its hoard.

name: Ridge Wyrm
lore: A wolf-sized wyrm that burrows in the fallen scales and hunts the ridge at dusk.

name: Scale Hoarder
lore: A squirrel-thing that buries scales like acorns and defends the cache with a hoard's fury.

name: Hoard Warden
lore: The hoard's keeper, a lion of storm and shadow that counts the coins by name and takes offense at theft.

name: Coin Mimic
lore: A chest of coins that is not a chest of coins, and resents the confusion.

name: Hoard Howler
lore: A hound that guards the hoard's edge and howls at anything that glitters.

name: Bloodfen Wyrm
lore: A crocodile-wyrm fattened on the fen's old blood, sluggish and enormous and immortal.

name: Fen Hatchling I
lore: A hatchling that has never left the fen and thinks it is the whole world.

name: Fen Hatchling II
lore: A hatchling that has never left the fen and thinks it is the whole world.

name: Broodmother
lore: The broodmother of the wyrms, a tiger-drake whose molten stripes mark each egg she guards and each foe she has buried.

name: Wyrmling I
lore: A new-hatched drake, hungry and already armored.

name: Wyrmling II
lore: A new-hatched drake, hungry and already armored.

name: Cradle Coil
lore: A coil of the cradle that never sleeps, tightening around anything that enters the pit.

name: Cradle Keeper
lore: A keeper that has guarded the cradle since the spine was alive.

name: Shell Drake
lore: A drake that carries the cradle's old shell and the patience that comes with it.

name: Sky Warden
lore: A guardian of storm and shadow that catches the falling sky and hurls it back.

name: Temple Coil I
lore: A coil that has wrapped the temple's broken pillars and never let go.

name: Temple Coil II
lore: A coil that has wrapped the temple's broken pillars and never let go.

name: Ruin Drake
lore: A drake that took the temple as its den and the falling sky as its weather.

name: Elder Wyrm
lore: The eldest of the spine's wyrms, a crocodile of molten rock and old gold that has outlived every knight sent to kill it.

name: Court Coil
lore: A coil of the court, draped across the throne's arm like a favorite ribbon.

name: Bone Herald
lore: The court's crier, armored in the remains of the last herald.

name: Egg Guardian
lore: The last guardian of the last egg, holding the line with storm in its mane and shadow at its heels.

name: Clutch Thief I
lore: A drake that has been trying to steal the last egg since it was laid.

name: Clutch Thief II
lore: A drake that has been trying to steal the last egg since it was laid.

name: Spine Wyrm
lore: The spine's own wyrm, woken by the warmth of the last egg.

name: Voragrim
lore: The great drake whose spine is the road you walked, woken at last; its stripes are lava veins and its roar cracks the citadel's walls.

name: Spine Herald
lore: The drake's herald, carrying its roar down the ridge.

name: Wyrm Guard I
lore: A guard of storm and shadow, standing where the drake will not be touched.

name: Wyrm Guard II
lore: A guard of storm and shadow, standing where the drake will not be touched.

name: Drake Choir
lore: The dragon's chorus, humming the note that wakes the mountain.

name: Gate Warden
lore: The citadel's gate warden, a lion of storm and shadow that has never once let anyone leave.

name: Gate Hound I
lore: A hound of the gate that keeps a ledger of arrivals and a shorter list of departures.

name: Gate Hound II
lore: A hound of the gate that keeps a ledger of arrivals and a shorter list of departures.

name: Ash Revenant
lore: A courtier of the citadel reduced to ash and grief, still bowing to a throne that has moved on.

name: Courtyard Crawler
lore: A crawler that feeds on the courtyard's ash and whatever it is made of.

name: Oathbreaker
lore: What remains of a knight who swore to the dark lord and kept the oath too well.

name: Broken Warden
lore: A warden that broke its oath and now breaks anyone who reminds it.

name: Pledge Shade
lore: A shade of the pledged, still keeping a promise no one remembers making.

name: Gallery Shade
lore: A portrait that left its frame and has been looking for a body ever since.

name: Screaming Coil I
lore: A coil of the gallery that screams in a voice the paintings all borrowed.

name: Screaming Coil II
lore: A coil of the gallery that screams in a voice the paintings all borrowed.

name: Framed Horror
lore: A light that escaped a canvas and drifts the gallery's dark, looking for a way back in.

name: Warden of Nine Locks
lore: The citadel's jailer, a beast of nine chains, one for each lock it has never let anyone pass.

name: Lock Hound I
lore: A hound on the Warden's chain, one of nine.

name: Lock Hound II
lore: A hound on the Warden's chain, one of nine.

name: Antechamber Guard
lore: A guard of shadow that has stood so long it has forgotten what it guards, only that it does.

name: Throne Herald
lore: The throne's herald, whose bow is the last courtesy you will be shown.

name: Court Revenant I
lore: A revenant of the court, still dressed for a session that ended long ago.

name: Court Revenant II
lore: A revenant of the court, still dressed for a session that ended long ago.

name: Masked Noble
lore: A courtier whose mask is the only part of it left, and it is very attached to the part.

name: Mask Bearer
lore: A bearer who carries the masks the nobles have outgrown.

name: Masquerade Shade
lore: A shade in the shape of whoever it is standing next to.

name: Hollow Chancellor
lore: The dark lord's chancellor, a voice with no body and a crown with no king, ruling the court while its master watches.

name: Chancellor's Guard I
lore: A guard of the chancellor's court, standing nearer the throne than anything should.

name: Chancellor's Guard II
lore: A guard of the chancellor's court, standing nearer the throne than anything should.

name: Hollow Herald
lore: The chancellor's herald, made of the same emptiness as its master.

name: The Dark Lord's Shadow
lore: The shadow the dark lord casts, cut loose and grown vast, holding the inner chamber until its master is ready.

name: Shadow Legion I
lore: A legion of the shadow's making, each one a lesser dark lord.

name: Shadow Legion II
lore: A legion of the shadow's making, each one a lesser dark lord.

name: Shadow Legion III
lore: A legion of the shadow's making, each one a lesser dark lord.

name: Wing of Ash
lore: The shadow's eye, circling the chamber and reporting your every breath.

name: The Dark Lord
lore: The master of the citadel and the shadow over every road you walked: a lord of storm, shadow, and dragonfire who does not intend to lose the last room.

name: Dragonfire Herald
lore: The dark lord's herald, whose stripes are the drake-fire of the spine road.

name: Bloodsworn Guard
lore: A guard sworn in dragon's blood and armored in the mountain's own skin.
